question: Which of the two overlapping open debug-proxy CA recovery implementations should be the canonical landing path?
rationale: Both branches address the same failure class with different locking and publication designs, and the alternative PR is neither merged nor currently established as a viable replacement for this one.

options.title: Advance this PR after fresh proof
options.body: Request exact-head terminal proof for this branch, then review it as the canonical timeout-and-recovery implementation.

options.title: Adopt the alternate recovery PR
options.body: Choose https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/109946 only after confirming its current mergeability and that it also covers the required timeout behavior.

options.title: Consolidate into a new narrow patch
options.body: Close neither branch until an owner extracts one agreed design with one locking and publication contract.

recommendation.title: Advance this PR after fresh proof
recommendation.body: Request exact-head terminal proof for this branch, then review it as the canonical timeout-and-recovery implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main feature ownership could not be attributed reliably from the supplied history context.
